# Shared laundry drying

- Three adults share the flat and one folding drying rack in the spare room.
- We each wash clothes on different days, without an agreed routine for using the rack.
- Two of us often finish a wash and find that the rack is already full.
- Last winter we tried leaving a note on the washing machine, but stopped using it after a few weeks.
- The landlord will not allow a tumble dryer to be installed.
- We agreed to spend no more than £25 in total on changes.
